# Strictly Simone

> Strictly Simone is a DJ who mixes music, some of it mashups. There is no fixed genre: it is whatever she feels like playing at the time, and she just wants to make people smile.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.strictlysimone.com/): Simone, and the song she has on repeat.
- [About](https://www.strictlysimone.com/about.html): Who Simone is and how she mixes.
- [Privacy](https://www.strictlysimone.com/privacy.html): What the site does and does not collect.
